{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies CMakeLists.txt and cmake/ modules to propagate CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR and CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR into the build configuration.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes installation layout resolution for distributions like Arch Linux that set `CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBEXECDIR` to `lib`. On those systems, the installed wrapper currently fails immediately with `No such file or directory` when attempting to execute installed binaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin.cpp to locate multiprocess binaries (such as bitcoin-node) dynamically using configured build paths.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Enables the multiprocess wrapper to correctly resolve and launch internal target executables across non-default install layouts. Without this, multiprocess execution fails immediately on startup under distributions with custom libexec paths."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin.cpp and test/functional/tool_bitcoin.py, which govern the bitcoin CLI wrapper tool.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves startup execution failures in the `bitcoin` wrapper command when installed on systems using custom binary directory layouts. As the tool is still primarily in development alongside multiprocess work, this fix is worthwhile for tooling correctness."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
